label: moves or travels to
definition: X undertakes travel, relocation, return or other movement with geographic destination Y.
scope_notes: Direction is traveler or relocating organization to destination. Moving/returning/arriving and leaving for Y qualify. Leaving from Y, mere presence, sports event participation, ownership and professional affiliation do not. Military invasion-only cases retain the previous explicit scope ambiguity.

facts.reason: Americans explicitly visit Vietnam, supporting movement to the destination. Missing, serving, fighting and dying there are different attached meanings.
Dodgers return to Brooklyn and are brought to it. Departure and move-from rows can describe other events and remain mixed evidence.
Browns repeatedly move and relocate to Baltimore, including leaving for that destination.
Raiders explicitly move to Los Angeles; move-from, playing and remaining there are additional event meanings.
Mets return to Shea Stadium, explicitly expressing destination-directed movement. Playing, games and victories there are additional venue facts.
